thread:
maddie: quick PRD intake — proposal: Eval gate for model rollouts. Problem: we keep seeing subtle regressions after model swaps (relevance / hallucinations / safety hits) that only customers notice in prod. Need a formal, automated quality gate that can block or rollback canary->prod if eval fails.

maddie: goals: 1) automatic pre-rollout eval against curated prompt set, 2) define clear pass/fail thresholds (accuracy/safety/semantic-sim), 3) integrate with Console rollout UI for canary gating, 4) audit logs for compliance.

maddie: non-goals: we are NOT building a full human-in-the-loop moderation workflow in phase 1, not solving dataset drift automatic retraining, not changing model hosting infra.

maddie: proposed success metrics: pass rate >= 98% on curated eval set; safety hits <= baseline + 0.1%; no customer-facing regression tickets in first 14 days after rollout for gated rollouts.

sanjay: question — runtime constraints? do we run evals in parallel on Dedicated GPUs or use ephemeral hosted workers? impacts cost and latency.

erica: ML note — we should include multiple metrics: semantic-similarity (SBERT cosine) threshold, exact-match for structured outputs, and a safety classifier hit-rate. Also run on both small and long prompts to catch context-length regressions.

erica: suggested thresholds example: semantic sim >= 0.85 median, top-1 EM >= 92%, safety hits <= previous model + 0.1%. can tweak after initial baseline run.

maddie: AC (acceptance criteria) draft: 
1) There is a Console toggle to enable "Eval Gate" on a rollout policy (per-model).
2) When enabled, pre-rollout job executes full eval on the selected eval-set and produces a pass/fail result.
3) Rollout automatically halts and flags canary if any configured hard threshold is violated.
4) All eval results, diffs vs baseline, and the failing prompts are stored in audit logs and visible in the model rollout UI.
5) There is a manual override with reason required (audited) to proceed.

sanjay: implementation notes: executor should be a job in the orchestration layer. need API: POST /models/:id/eval-run { eval_set_id, baseline_model_id, thresholds } -> run_id. returns results JSON.

sanjay: cost estimate: for 5k eval prompts at typical token lengths we'll need ~2 GPU-minutes on A100 quantized path; we should allow customers to provide smaller v. larger eval sets.

erica: sample eval command for CI / on-prem: 
```
redwood eval run --model rwd/large-v2 --baseline rwd/large-v1 --eval-set customers-high-priority.json --thresholds thresholds.yaml
```

ian: SRE concerns: need timeouts, retries, resource quotas. If eval job stalls we must not block global rollout pipeline. Propose: default cap of 30m, soft timeout at 10m with warning to PM, and kill+fail at 30m. Also pagination for storing diffs so UI doesn't OOM.

jordan: UX ask: in Console rollout screen show three things: pass/fail badge, delta heatmap (semantic + safety + latency), and a one-click detailed view that links to failing prompts and model responses. Also add a small inline explainer about thresholds and overrides.

maddie: edge cases: 
- eval-set too small -> flaky pass/fail (we should warn if <500 prompts).
- stochastic model outputs -> require deterministic seeds or exact-match relaxed metric.
- config drift: baseline_model_id missing -> fallback to previous deployed model.

erica: test plan: run the eval-gate against last 10 releases, verify it would have caught 3 historical regressions. record false positives/negatives and iterate thresholds.

sanjay: rough rollout plan: phase 1 internal only (opt-in) -> phase 2 customer opt-in (beta) -> phase 3 on by default for Dedicated customers.

ian: monitoring: emit metrics: eval.run.duration, eval.run.pass_rate, eval.run.failure_reasons, rollback.count. Hook alerts for pass_rate drop > 2 sigma.

maddie: asks for owners: product (maddie) for scope and acceptance criteria; eng (sanjay) for API + orch; ML (erica) for eval set curation and thresholds; SRE (ian) for infra/limits; design (jordan) for Console UX.

maddie: next steps: I'll draft a one-pager PRD with AC + success metrics and share here by EOD Friday. Please respond with any hard blockers by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deployment note: canary-gate feature-flag currently off in prod.

jordan: :eyes: will sketch UI flows after PRD.

sanjay: will prototype API + mock eval-run by next week, marking dependencies in JIRA.

maddie: thanks all — keeping this thread as intake.
